title: Block insert with {key:Ctrl-V}{key:I}
summary: Prefix every line in a column selection at once.

frames.caption: {key:I} types on the first row only — for now.
{key:Esc} replays the insert on every selected row.
frames.narration: Block {key:A} appends past the right edge the same way. This is the fastest column edit in Vim.
